scope: Analytical transfer assessment; no trainer changes or new training jobs.
binary_identity: E[R sigmoid(R*l/eta)|s,a] = Q(s,a) sigmoid(l/eta), for R in {0,1}, no baseline, and fixed measurable l.
continuous_target: E[(G-b) sigmoid((G-b)*l/eta)|s,a,policy_context]; multiply by 2 for our convention.
qualifications: Existing mean-advantage DG and conditional sampled-return DG have different estimands; the former is not automatically a bug.
Scalar mean Q and latent V do not determine nonlinear return utility.
No additive scalar Bellman recursion for gated coefficient.
Correct conditional coefficient retains DG exploration pressure and is not established to fix excessive sigma.
Q/(1+density) is not the binary simplification for real-valued HalfCheetah returns.
Current fixed-sigma .2 continuation differs from current stochastic actor policy.
Existing critic already nonlinear, action-conditioned, separate from actor parameters.
recommendation: If testing conditional sampled-return DG, learn a policy-consistent return distribution and integrate the whole gated utility, or train a coefficient critic on valid trajectory-return labels. Do not gate predicted coefficient again. Retain existing mean-Q lane for comparisons.
validation: Scalar numerical evaluation and independent team analysis; inspected source's reported 300 finite-action checks, did not rerun those checks.
